Institutional Footprint — How to Read It

🏦

Put/Call OI Ratio

Total put open interest ÷ total call open interest, across all expiries.

  • ≥ 1.5 — heavy institutional put hedging, strong floor support
  • 1.0 – 1.5 — moderate put positioning, supportive
  • < 1.0 — call-heavy, bullish lean, less downside hedge
🧱

Whale Put Wall

The strike with the highest total PUT open interest — the institutional "cushion" price.

  • Strike ≤ Whale Put Wall → selling alongside institutions ✓
  • Strike > Whale Put Wall → less institutional support below you
🚧

Whale Call Wall

The strike with the highest total CALL open interest — the institutional resistance ceiling.

  • Price < Call Wall → range-bound, safer for CSP ✓
  • Price > Call Wall → resistance broken, less predictable
✅

Ideal CSP setup

All three institutional signals aligned in your favour:

  • Put/Call OI ratio ≥ 1.5
  • Strike ≤ Whale Put Wall
  • Current price < Whale Call Wall

CSP Pick Tracker

1Open picks right now

Every Top-20 SELL CSP pick logged in recommendation_log.csv that hasn't expired yet, marked to the latest scan. Cushion is how far the stock sits above the strike. My Positions · puts & covered calls

Track your own cash-secured puts & covered calls

Load your own trade list and this tab shows your open positions (priced from the latest scan), realized gain / loss by month, quarter and year to date, and puts vs covered calls. Two ways to get your file:

  1. Excel ledger (recommended): download the template, type one row per option you sell, save it, then upload it here. It also works on its own in Excel: totals, budget left and a Monthly Summary calculate themselves.
  2. CSV: export from your own spreadsheet with the column names below (or start from the CSV template).
⬇ Excel template or drag the file onto this box

🔒 Your file is read inside your own browser only. Nothing is uploaded to any server and nobody else can see it. It is remembered on this device so you don't need to re-upload every visit (use Clear to remove it).

Prices come from the latest screener scan built into this page (stock price as of the scan date). Option now is the scan's bid/ask mid when your exact put is in the scan, otherwise a Black-Scholes estimate (est.) using the implied volatility of the nearest strike the scan has for that stock. Tickers the scanner doesn't cover show NO PRICE; realized P&L still works for them. Cushion: for a put, how far the stock can fall before the strike; for a covered call, how far it can rise before your shares get called away. Estimates only: always check the live quote with your broker. Not financial advice.
Stock prices are the latest Yahoo close when the dashboard is built on your PC, otherwise the latest scan that had the ticker. Option now is the live Yahoo bid/ask mid for your exact put or call (last = last trade when no bid/ask), else the scan's mid (puts only), else a Black-Scholes estimate (est.) using the IV of the nearest quoted strike (est. HV = 30-day historical volatility, roughest). Hover a tag for its source. Cushion: for a put, how far the stock can fall before the strike; for a covered call, how far it can rise before your shares get called away (ITM). Covered calls are secured by shares (100 per contract), so they don't use cash budget. If a call is assigned, only the premium counts here; the share sale belongs in your share portfolio. Log new trades and closes in CSP_Portfolio.xlsx (Type = Put or Call); the next build picks them up. Always check the live quote in moomoo before acting.

SELL TO OPEN — selling a cash-secured put obligates you to BUY 100 shares per contract at the strike price if assigned. The full cash (strike × 100 × contracts) must sit in your brokerage account while the position is open.

Probability of expiring worthless = 1 − |Delta| (Black–Scholes approximation). Real probability depends on market moves and implied-volatility changes.

Data source: Yahoo Finance (unofficial, ~15–20 min delayed) via the CSP Screener Suite (csp_screener.py → csp_ranker.py). Always verify live prices and open interest in your broker before placing any trade, and check the earnings calendar — a stock reporting before expiry can gap down and force assignment at a loss.

Nothing in this dashboard is financial advice. This is a personal analytics tool for reviewing your own screener output.
